about_the_game:
[ About the Game / Story Summary ]

Uncover the secrets of a mysterious planet and build heartfelt connections with your beautiful teammates in this romantic space adventure♡

  • Beautiful full-color artwork! Special events with each unique character await!

  • What will you say to win her heart? Choose wisely♡

  • Follow branching storylines and collect clues that reveal the truth. Feeling stuck? Don’t worry—you’re not alone!

  • Navigate danger, outsmart deadly threats, and search for fuel. What truth lies at the end of your path?

You wake up on an unfamiliar planet after a crash landing—your memory, gone.
Alongside the teammates who’ve been waiting for you, you set out to find fuel and return home.

But instead of looking for fuel, you’re getting a little too close to your alluring teammates, and strange “rumors” keep popping up all over the planet...

They say there's a monster out there... one that eats people?

Surrounded by danger and mystery, will you be able to unveil the planet’s secrets, secure the fuel, and survive the journey home?

[ Character Profiles ]

You

"My head... it hurts. I can’t remember anything."

  • You wake up from cryosleep after a crash landing—with no memories of who you are or what went wrong.

  • Now stuck on a strange planet, you team up with your teammates to search for fuel and find a way home.

  • But while you're trying to focus, some of your teammates seem oddly fixated on you. Secretly... you’re not really complaining.

Ran

"Do I still look like a kid to you?"

  • Ran may be small and cute, but she’s the ship’s captain—and she takes that role seriously.

  • She acts strict and mature to make up for her youthful looks, sometimes coming off a bit old-fashioned.

  • But under that tough act, there’s a sweet side she tries to hide… and when it shows, it’s impossible to ignore.

Erine

"It’s okay. I already know—even if you don’t say it."

  • Erine is calm, caring, and always smiling. She brings peace to the team with her warm presence.

  • She’s thoughtful, graceful, and seems to understand everything without needing to ask.

  • Confident and dependable—but what happens if that smile ever fades?

Nana

"You’ll still say I’m your favorite, right?"

  • Nana is the energetic one who ran straight to you with open arms the moment you woke up.

  • She’s cheerful, playful, and incredibly affectionate—sometimes a bit too much. Still, her puppy-like charm makes her impossible to dislike.

  • When she messes up and gets down on herself, all she wants is a warm hug and some kind words.

Haru

"I’m not like the others. I love you for real."

  • Haru is quiet and shy, but she always keeps her eyes on you.

  • With her soft pink hair and gentle gaze, she feels like someone out of a dream.

  • Though she may blush and stumble over her words, her quiet heart speaks with deep, honest love.

short_description: Crash-landed on a mysterious planet shrouded in secrets?! Team up with your captivating, stunning, and irresistibly cute teammates to hunt for fuel and make your way back home! A space romance adventure that’s sure to steal your heart!
